# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.0 Wave 1 Package 3, Playable Rus' Phase 1 (1337-1480, oe_rpl_). Generated by gen_rus_playable.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Ultra-lightweight human-Rus' fallback monthly pulse.
# When scheduler slot 44 (BYZ) has already ticked this month, oe_rpl_ran_m matches oe_rpl_m_now and this trigger is false.
# Ensures Playable Rus' keeps running seamlessly even if Byzantium falls (e.g. 1453) or before slot 44 is regenerated.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_rpl_fallback_pulse } }

oe_rpl_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1337
        is_rebel_country = no
        NOT = { global_var:oe_rpl_ran_m ?= oe_rpl_m_now }
        oe_rpl_eligible = yes
    }
    effect = {
        oe_ml_mark_start = yes
        if = { limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes } oe_rpl_monthly = yes }
    }
}
